observations: Photo 0: Front view of a cream-colored air fryer with a silver control panel and dial. The brand name 'CLARUM' is visible on the handle and below the dial. The dial has markings for time (e.g., 15, 20, 25) and temperature (e.g., 160, 180, 200).
Photo 1: Air fryer with the basket pulled out, showing the black non-stick basket with a perforated base. The handle has 'CLARUM' printed on it. A hand is holding the basket.
Photo 2: Same front view as photo 0, with the brand name 'CLARUM' visible on the handle and below the dial. The control dial is centered, with time and temperature markings.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI FAVOUR'.
The air fryer appears to be a basic model with a single dial for time and temperature control, no digital display or buttons.
The exterior shows minor scuffs and wear, especially on the handle and around the dial area.

claims.claim: Quality portable clarium Air fryer available
claims.evidence: Photos show a Clarium air fryer with a clean, intact design and visible brand name on multiple parts (handle, front panel).
No visual proof of testing or operation. The photos show the unit in a static state; no power cord, plug, or operation is visible.

risks.proof: A video showing the air fryer plugged in, turning on, and the dial responding (e.g., indicator light or fan noise).

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug, showing length, condition, and compatibility with Nigerian outlets.

risks.risk: The non-stick basket or interior may be scratched or damaged, affecting performance or safety.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the basket interior and base, showing condition of the coating.

proof_requests: Video of the air fryer turning on and operating (dial response, indicator light, fan noise).
Photo of the power cord and plug, showing full length and condition.
Close-up photo of the basket interior to check for scratches or damage.
response.reason: The brand and type are identifiable, but critical functional and condition risks (operation, cord, basket) cannot be verified from the current photos. The 'TESTED AND TRUSTED' claim is unverifiable remotely. Price cannot be set without proof of functionality and completeness.
